# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/gen_tool_docs.py` from the tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

bluelink-mcp has **24 tools** in **5 groups**: 7 read, 16 write and 1 unlock.

Each tool is labelled with the setting it needs:

| Label | Registered when |
|---|---|
| 🟢 read | Always, except `bluelink_get_vehicle_location`, which needs `BLUELINK_ALLOW_LOCATION=true` |
| 🟠 write | `BLUELINK_ALLOW_WRITES=true` |
| 🔴 unlock | `BLUELINK_ALLOW_WRITES=true` and `BLUELINK_ALLOW_UNLOCK=true` |

Every tool takes an optional `vehicle` (name, VIN or ID), which you can leave out when the account has one car. Commands wait for the car to confirm by default (`wait`), which usually takes 20 to 60 seconds.

## Contents

- [`status`](#status): The car's state as Bluelink last heard it, live refreshes, location and command results.
- [`history`](#history): Driving history and daily energy use.
- [`climate`](#climate): Pre-conditioning the cabin: temperature, defrost, heated rear window, steering wheel and seats.
- [`charging`](#charging): Starting and stopping charging, charge limits and current, battery conditioning, the charge port, and the charging and departure schedules.
- [`security`](#security): Locks, windows, hazard lights and horn.

## status

The car's state as Bluelink last heard it, live refreshes, location and command results.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`bluelink_list_vehicles`](#bluelink_list_vehicles) | 🟢 read | List vehicles |
| [`bluelink_get_vehicle_status`](#bluelink_get_vehicle_status) | 🟢 read | Get vehicle status |
| [`bluelink_refresh_vehicle_status`](#bluelink_refresh_vehicle_status) | 🟢 read | Refresh vehicle status from the car |
| [`bluelink_get_vehicle_location`](#bluelink_get_vehicle_location) | 🟢 read | Get vehicle location |
| [`bluelink_get_command_status`](#bluelink_get_command_status) | 🟢 read | Get command status |

### bluelink_list_vehicles

🟢 read

List the vehicles on the account, as {total, returned, items}.

_No arguments._

### bluelink_get_vehicle_status

🟢 read

Get the car's last reported state: battery and fuel, range, charging, climate, locks, doors, windows, tyres, warnings and charging schedule. Does not wake the car.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |

### bluelink_refresh_vehicle_status

🟢 read

Wake the car and fetch live state, then return it like bluelink_get_vehicle_status. Uses a little 12V battery and API quota, so it is rate limited.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |

### bluelink_get_vehicle_location

🟢 read

Get where the car is parked (latitude/longitude, and an address if geocoding is on).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |

### bluelink_get_command_status

🟢 read

Check whether an earlier remote command succeeded (pending, success, failed, timeout).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action_id` | string | yes |  | The action_id a command returned. |
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |

## history

Driving history and daily energy use.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`bluelink_get_trips`](#bluelink_get_trips) | 🟢 read | Get trips |
| [`bluelink_get_energy_usage`](#bluelink_get_energy_usage) | 🟢 read | Get daily energy usage |

### bluelink_get_trips

🟢 read

Get driving history: trips for a day, or a month's summary with trip counts per day. Not every region supports this (Europe does).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `date` | string |  |  | YYYY-MM-DD for that day's trips, or YYYY-MM for a month summary. Defaults to today in the car's time zone. |

### bluelink_get_energy_usage

🟢 read

Get daily electric energy use (Wh) split into driving, climate, electronics and battery care, plus regenerated energy and distance, newest day first, as {total, returned, items}. EVs and PHEVs in some regions.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `hours` | number |  | `168` | How far back to look, in hours (up to 744, 31 days). The car reports whole days, so this is rounded up to whole days: 24 or less gives the latest day. |

## climate

Pre-conditioning the cabin: temperature, defrost, heated rear window, steering wheel and seats.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`bluelink_start_climate`](#bluelink_start_climate) | 🟠 write | Start climate control |
| [`bluelink_stop_climate`](#bluelink_stop_climate) | 🟠 write | Stop climate control |

### bluelink_start_climate

🟠 write

Start pre-conditioning the cabin (heating or cooling). Seat settings only apply to cars that support them. On a plug-in hybrid this runs from the high-voltage battery.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `temperature` | number |  | `21` | Target cabin temperature, 14-30 °C, in 0.5 steps. Always in °C; in the USA it is converted to whole °F (62-82). |
| `duration_minutes` | integer |  | `10` | How long to run. |
| `defrost` | boolean |  | `false` | Front windscreen defrost. |
| `heated_rear_window_and_mirrors` | boolean |  | `false` | Heat the rear window and door mirrors. |
| `heated_steering_wheel` | boolean |  | `false` | Heat the steering wheel. |
| `front_left_seat` | `off` \| `low_heat` \| `medium_heat` \| `high_heat` \| `low_cool` \| `medium_cool` \| `high_cool` |  |  | Seat heating or ventilation, on cars that have it. Leave out to not ask for a change. In the USA and Canada, Bluelink turns a seat that is left out off. |
| `front_right_seat` | `off` \| `low_heat` \| `medium_heat` \| `high_heat` \| `low_cool` \| `medium_cool` \| `high_cool` |  |  | Seat heating or ventilation, on cars that have it. Leave out to not ask for a change. In the USA and Canada, Bluelink turns a seat that is left out off. |
| `rear_left_seat` | `off` \| `low_heat` \| `medium_heat` \| `high_heat` \| `low_cool` \| `medium_cool` \| `high_cool` |  |  | Seat heating or ventilation, on cars that have it. Leave out to not ask for a change. In the USA and Canada, Bluelink turns a seat that is left out off. |
| `rear_right_seat` | `off` \| `low_heat` \| `medium_heat` \| `high_heat` \| `low_cool` \| `medium_cool` \| `high_cool` |  |  | Seat heating or ventilation, on cars that have it. Leave out to not ask for a change. In the USA and Canada, Bluelink turns a seat that is left out off. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_stop_climate

🟠 write

Stop cabin pre-conditioning.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_start_charging

🟠 write

Start charging now (the car must be plugged in). Overrides a charging schedule.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_stop_charging

🟠 write

Stop charging.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_set_charge_limits

🟠 write

Set the maximum charge level. Mainly for EVs; many plug-in hybrids don't support it.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ac_percent` | integer | yes |  | Limit for AC (home/public) charging. |
| `dc_percent` | integer | yes |  | Limit for DC rapid charging. |
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_set_charging_current

🟠 write

Limit the current the car draws when AC charging, e.g. to go easy on a weak household socket or circuit. Recent EVs in Europe, Australia, New Zealand, China and India.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `percent` | `100` \| `90` \| `60` | yes |  | Maximum AC charging current, as a share of the full current: 100, 90 or 60. |
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_start_battery_conditioning

🟠 write

Start warming (or cooling) the high-voltage battery, so it charges faster and the car has more range when it's cold. Uses energy from the battery, or from the charger when plugged in. EVs in europe-cci only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_stop_battery_conditioning

🟠 write

Stop conditioning the high-voltage battery. EVs in europe-cci only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

🟠 write

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |

### bluelink_set_charging_schedule

🟠 write

Change the car's scheduled (off-peak) charging: on or off, and the off-peak window. Settings left out keep their current values, read from the car's last reported state; the result shows the whole schedule that was sent. EVs and plug-in hybrids in Europe, Australia, New Zealand, China and India.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scheduled_charging` | boolean |  |  | Turn scheduled charging on or off. Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `off_peak_start` | string |  |  | 24-hour local time, HH:MM. Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `off_peak_end` | string |  |  | 24-hour local time, HH:MM. Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `off_peak_only` | boolean |  |  | Charge only in the off-peak window (true), or prefer it but charge outside it when needed (false). Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_set_departure_schedule

🟠 write

Change one of the car's two departure times: when it repeats, and whether to pre-condition the cabin (and charge) to be ready by then. Settings left out keep their current values, read from the car's last reported state; the result shows the departure that was sent. On some cars the climate settings are shared by both departures. EVs and plug-in hybrids in Europe, Australia, New Zealand, China and India.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slot` | `1` \| `2` | yes |  | Which of the car's two departure times to change. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  |  | Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `days` | array |  |  | The days it repeats on. Leave out to keep them as they are. |
| `time` | string |  |  | 24-hour local time, HH:MM. Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `climate` | boolean |  |  | Pre-condition the cabin for this departure. Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `temperature` | number |  |  | Cabin temperature for the departure, 17-27 °C in 0.5 steps. Always in °C; converted for cars set to °F. Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `defrost` | boolean |  |  | Defrost the windscreen. Leave out to keep it as is. |
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_lock_vehicle

🟠 write

Lock the car's doors.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_unlock_vehicle

🔴 unlock

Unlock the car's doors. Only do this when the user clearly asks for it. With several cars on the account, give the car's exact name, VIN or ID. The server asks the user to confirm. If the client can't show that question, the call fails until `confirm` is set to the car's name or the last 6 characters of its VIN: ask the user first, and never guess or reuse an earlier answer.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `confirm` | string |  |  | Only needed when the MCP client can't ask the user itself (no elicitation support): the car's name or the last 6 characters of its VIN, exactly as bluelink_list_vehicles or bluelink_get_vehicle_status show them. Ask the user before setting it. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_close_windows

🟠 write

Close all four side windows, e.g. when the user left one open and rain is coming. There is deliberately no tool to open them. Not every car has remote window control; not available in the USA or Canada.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_flash_hazard_lights

🟠 write

Flash the hazard lights briefly, e.g. to find the car in a car park. Not available in Canada or for Kia in the USA.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |

### bluelink_sound_horn_and_flash_lights

🟠 write

Sound the horn and flash the hazard lights for a short while, e.g. to find the car. It is loud and can disturb people nearby, so only do this when the user asks for the horn; to just find the car, prefer bluelink_flash_hazard_lights. Not available in Canada or for Kia in the USA.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string |  |  | Vehicle name, VIN or ID. Optional if the account has one vehicle. |
| `wait` | boolean |  | `true` | Wait (up to ~60 s) for the car to confirm the command. If it hasn't by then, the status is pending: check later with bluelink_get_command_status. |
